question: Which of the following is a recognised sub-discipline of Forensic Medicine?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Forensic Pathology is one of the six recognised sub-disciplines, concerned with the examination of bodies to determine cause and manner of death.
Incorrect. Forensic Pharmacokinetics is not a recognised sub-discipline. The correct disciplines include Forensic Pathology, Serology, Odontology, Psychiatry, Toxicology, and Anthropology.
Incorrect. This is not a recognised sub-discipline of Forensic Medicine.

overallFeedback.feedback: Forensic Medicine has six recognised sub-disciplines: Forensic Pathology, Forensic Serology, Forensic Odontology, Forensic Psychiatry, Forensic Toxicology, and Forensic Anthropology.
